messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

You can now enter an optional **Game name** under “Reproduce a game.” The name is saved with your progress and restored when you load it. Older unnamed saves remain compatible.

I also fixed imports that failed when snapshot properties appeared in a different order.

Validation passed: type checking, all 141 unit tests, and all 78 browser tests on the project’s named runtime combination. The changed files pass formatting; the repository-wide formatting check reports three untouched files that were already out of format.
